statusLine.command: input=$(cat); seg() { printf '\033[0;%sm%s%s\033[0m' "$1" "${2:+$2 }" "$3"; }; dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); out="$(seg 34 "" "$(basename "$dir")")"; br=$(git -C "$dir" --no-optional-locks symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$br" ]; then [ -n "$(git -C "$dir" --no-optional-locks status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ] && br="$br*"; out="$out $(seg 32 "$(printf '\356\261\257')" "$br")"; fi; model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name + (if .thinking.enabled == false then " (no thinking)" elif .effort.level then " (\(.effort.level))" else "" end)'); out="$out $(seg 38\;5\;15 "$(printf '\356\262\202')" "$model")"; bars=$(echo "$input" | jq -r 'def col($a; $b): if . >= $b then "\u001b[1;31m" elif . >= $a then "\u001b[1;33m" else "\u001b[1;38;5;7m" end; [(.rate_limits.five_hour // empty | ([((.resets_at - now) / 60 | floor), 0] | max) as $m | " \u001b[0;33m󰅐 " + (.used_percentage | col(50; 90)) + "\(.used_percentage | floor)% (\(if $m >= 60 then "\($m / 60 | floor)h\($m % 60)m" else "\($m)m" end))"), (.context_window.used_percentage // empty | " \u001b[0;35m󰍛 " + col(50; 90) + "\(floor)%")] | join("")'); printf '%s%s\033[00m' "$out" "$bars"
